notes: A brighter, friendlier log in and sign up page
Show or hide your password while you type it
Sign up checks your password as you go
“You reserved…” emails are now short, plain receipts, so Gmail should stop putting them under Promotions
Emails are simpler and more personal, so Gmail should file them under Primary instead of Promotions
Paste a store link into the add bar and the gift starts filling in right away, with no need to press Add
Anything you typed before pasting, like the gift's name, is kept
On phones, the image link box in the gift editor is folded away under “Paste an image link” to keep things tidy
Long sizes and colors on a gift now wrap inside its card instead of running off the edge
The List layout fits on phones, with the price and buttons under the gift's name
Right after an update, a card like this one shows what's new
A heads-up when a new version is ready while the app is open, with what changed
Updates show up right away instead of the app sometimes staying on an old version
Pasting links works better on iPhone, including short links like a.co/…
Fixed the app looking zoomed in or out on iPhone
Two people can own one list together (great for weddings and babies)
Link gifts that go together, like earbuds and their case
A little confetti when you reserve or buy a gift
List owners can turn off chip-in and questions
A cleaner list header and a simpler add bar
